_note: SYNTHETIC demo data. Fictional operator Demo Kruusakarjaar OU. Not real.
raw_text: Hi, this is Mart from Synthetic Builders OU. We would like to order 250 tonnes of 0-16 crushed gravel, delivered to the Demo site about 22 km from the quarry. We have not ordered from you before. Preferred delivery next Tuesday. Thanks.

expected_demo_outcome.why: New customer ordering above 200 t must be on prepayment, so the order is escalated for a credit check rather than auto-confirmed.
